author: GamingBolt
description:
Yakuza Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties is Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio’s latest attempt at modernizing the older entries in the storied franchise, this time around focusing on the most archaic-feeling one of the bunch. 

It offers phenomenal visual upgrades and a great combat system while still maintaining the quality of its story, for good or bad, making it a great way for newer players to experience it. 

Dark Ties works as a great “expansion” of sorts to Yakuza Kiwami 3, since it gives you plenty of more of the game to enjoy once you’re done with the complex and long story of Kiryu’s attempts to run his orphanage.
title: Yakuza Kiwami 3 And Dark Ties Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Milestone has been quite vocal about its ambitions for Ride 6, the latest addition to a franchise that has built up quite a pedigree over the years. And from the looks of it, those ambitions might be realized in a simulation that comes so damn close to the real thing. 

It isn't just the shift to Unreal Engine 5 and the visual bump that the game has received, which is already a bump over the previous one. But it's in how those visuals interact with systems from physics to weather that make Ride 6 stand out as a motorcycle racing simulator worth its salt. It's seamless and works so well it casts a spell on its players, making for a very strong contender for the crown of the best looking racing simulator we've seen in a while.
title: RIDE 6 Graphics Analysis - Still The Best Looking Racing Series On The PS5 and PC?

author: GamingBolt
description:
PlayStation and Nintendo have made their fair share of mistakes, they're the market leaders – such problems have barely caused a dent in their bottom line. Microsoft doesn't need to catch up so much as prove that it can execute a plan like this with hiccups that won't affect the big picture.

When I first heard about Microsoft's designs to integrate Xbox with Windows more, branching out into areas that other competitors had very little reach – namely, the handheld PC market – I was somewhat optimistic. Now, I'm left to wonder whether its reach exceeds its grasp, and whether the brand itself, whatever it's worth, will just be a label slapped onto a random machine. If everything is an Xbox, then nothing is an Xbox – and at some point, it may be wiser for Microsoft to cut out the middle man for its grand hardware vision.
title: If EVERYTHING Is An Xbox, Then Nothing Is An Xbox...

author: GamingBolt
description: RIDE 6 is the motorcycling series at its most complete, where worthwhile onboarding, progression with momentum, and an overall reverence for two-wheel machinery outshines uneven presentation and a festival setting which misses the mark.
title: RIDE 6 Review - The Final Verdict
